name: German Vehicle Registration Plate (Kraftfahrzeugkennzeichen)
description:
Detects German vehicle registration plates. Format: 1-3 letter district code + 1-2 letter recognition digits + 1-4 digits with optional E (electric) or H (historic) suffix. Unicode flag required for umlaut characters in district codes.

Format: AB CD 1234 — 1-3 letter district + space + 1-2 letters + space + 1-4 digits + optional E/H
Official name: Kraftfahrzeugkennzeichen (KFZ-Kennzeichen)

effect.message: German vehicle plate tokenized for de-identification
